title: Yellow Saffron Argentinian Celeriac Empanadas
description: Resinous, silky celeriac empanadas with a yellow saffron twist, perfect for meal prep and low in calories. These empanadas are a flavorful twist on traditional Argentinian empanadas.

ingredients.name: Saffron threads
ingredients.notes: Soak the saffron threads in 1 tsp hot water

ingredients.name: Chicken egg
ingredients.notes: Beat the egg for the egg wash

instructions: In a large skillet, heat the lard over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add the lardons to the skillet and cook until browned.
Add the grated celeriac to the skillet and cook until softened.
Mix the soaked saffron threads with the hot water and add to the skillet.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, salt, lard, and garlic powder (if using). Mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until pliable.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece of dough into a thin circle.
Place a spoonful of the celeriac mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with the beaten egg for a golden glaze.
